# SafetyCulture

> > SafetyCulture provides an operations platform for workplace safety, quality control, and compliance management with IoT sensors, workflow automation, and enterprise integrations.

SafetyCulture offers industry-specific solutions for manufacturing, retail, hospitality, and facilities management, featuring ISO 45001/14001 compliance tools, SafetyCulture Sensors for cold-chain monitoring, and integrations with Power BI, Tableau, and other enterprise systems. The platform includes EdApp for training and supports Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) methodologies.

## Key Topics

- SafetyCulture Sensors
- ISO 45001 compliance
- ISO 14001 environmental management
- Workflow automation
- IoT sensors and monitoring
- Cold-chain management
- Risk assessment
- Quality control
- Total Productive Maintenance (TPM)
- EHS management
- Power BI and Tableau integration
- Food safety compliance
- Asset management
- Enterprise solutions
- EdApp training platform

## Health, Safety & Compliance

- [Risk Assessment](https://safetyculture.com/health-and-safety/risk-assessment): ISO 45001 & HACCP workplace safety and hazard identification platform
- [ISO 14001 Software & Solution](https://safetyculture.com/health-and-safety/iso-14001): ISO 14001 environmental management system with EHS and CAPA tracking
- [Manufacturing Compliance Software & Solution](https://safetyculture.com/manufacturing/manufacturing-compliance): ISO-compliant manufacturing quality control and safety inspection platform

## IoT Monitoring & Sensors

- [Refrigeration Monitoring System & Sensors](https://safetyculture.com/monitoring/refrigeration-monitoring): Wireless refrigeration monitoring with SafetyCulture Sensors for cold-chain
- [Temperature Data Logger & Sensors](https://safetyculture.com/monitoring/hot-cold-temperature-logger): IoT temperature data logger with real-time monitoring for food safety compliance

## Enterprise Solutions

- [Enterprise Management Software & Solution](https://safetyculture.com/enterprise/enterprise-management): All-in-one enterprise operations platform with Power BI & Tableau integration
- [Employee Engagement Software & Solutions](https://safetyculture.com/enterprise/employee-engagement): Enterprise employee engagement platform with training and workflow automation

## Manufacturing & Operations

- [Factory Equipment Reliability Software](https://safetyculture.com/manufacturing/factory-equipment-reliability): TPM-based equipment reliability software for manufacturing uptime optimization
- [Network Inventory Software](https://safetyculture.com/operational-excellence/network-inventory-software): Network infrastructure asset management and maintenance tracking software

## Retail & Hospitality

- [Retail Performance Management Software](https://safetyculture.com/retail/retail-performance-management): Retail performance analytics for audits, inventory, and loss prevention
- [Parking Audit Software and Solution](https://safetyculture.com/retail/parking-audit): Parking audit software for retail operations safety and hazard management
- [Event Management Software & Solution](https://safetyculture.com/hospitality/event-management): Hospitality event management platform for guest experience and compliance

## Facilities Management

- [Building Inspection Software](https://safetyculture.com/facilities-management/building-inspection-software): Digital building inspection checklists for facilities compliance management

## Partners & Resources

- [Partner Program](https://safetyculture.com/partner-program): SafetyCulture partner program for solution and services providers
- [Classroom Observation Form](https://safetyculture.com/forms/classroom-observation): Classroom observation form template for teacher evaluation and feedback
